name: VM (QEMU)
short_desc: Virtual machine in your browser - install any OS and access it via RDP
author: dockur
description: QEMU virtual machine container (qemux/qemu). Install any guest OS from the web console or an ISO URL, persist the virtual disk, and reach the guest over RDP. Requires KVM (/dev/kvm) on the host.

form_fields.label: Guest OS or ISO URL
form_fields.hint: A distro name supported by qemux/qemu (ubuntu, mint, debian, fedora, arch, alpine, kali...) or a direct ISO/image URL

form_fields.label: CPU Cores
form_fields.hint: CPU cores assigned to the VM

form_fields.label: RDP Port on Host
form_fields.hint: Host port forwarded to the guest RDP port (3389)
